snapshot.scope: Exact-Vault local database reset, rebuildable-root deletion boundary, and durable rebuild completion.

reviewers.task: Review exact-Vault reset and durable rebuild completion
reviewers.independence: Planning reviews the durable-data and repair contract; Development supplies separate Vault binding, reset-root, rebuild Job and shell integration evidence.

dimensions.summary: One confirmed Settings action retains the reviewed Vault identity through reset and completed rebuild instead of exposing deletion as a terminal state.
API, Settings, Vault ownership and Local Database design agree that only three rebuildable roots may be removed and the durable rebuild result is authoritative.
E1.08 and E1.09 now name the exact binding, preserved durable classes and completed index_rebuild Job while remaining partial until candidate publication.
VaultService remains the sole root-deletion owner and the existing rebuild service remains the sole index_rebuild Job owner.
Five existing owner documents bind the repair without a new design document or duplicated reset/rebuild contract.

verification.evidence: Wrong-Vault drift fails before deletion, the exact reviewed Vault resets only rebuildable roots, and every durable class remains present.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The combined reset-and-rebuild result compiles while Vault and rebuild ownership boundaries remain within their frozen budgets.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: API, Local Database, Settings, Playbook and durable decision ownership remain mutually consistent.

coordination.taskTitle: Bind exact-Vault reset to durable rebuild
coordination.compatibility: Existing manual rebuild behavior and durable Vault formats remain unchanged; reset now fails closed on binding drift and returns the completed rebuild result.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds E1.08 and E1.09 to the exact rebuildable-root and durable Job semantics without promoting unrelated acceptance.

nonBlockingRisks: macOS signing/notarization, signed update and packaged qualification remain open.
Windows public qualification and broader multilingual acceptance remain later.
